Alex R: Quick handoff for EngageBridge — sales signed SOW yesterday, onboarding kickoff Tue 9am PT. CC @Maya S for CS, @Talia for infra. Notes: 100k monthly tokens, VPC private deploy requested, SSO + SCIM.
Maya S: Thanks Alex. Owning onboarding. Can you drop the SOW link + initial contact info? I'll schedule enablement and kickoff.
Alex R: SOW here: https://drive.redwood/engagebridge/sow_v1.pdf. Primary contact: Priya K (Priya.K@engagebridge.com), technical lead: Sam O. Renewal cadence: annual, 90d notice.
Maya S: Got it. Early renewal risk: finance asked for usage caps in contract. Marking renewal-watch tag until first 90d.
Jorge L: Adding CS checklist items: 1) SSO test account 2) IP allowlist for private deploy 3) baseline eval prompts + dataset upload 4) billing webhook test. I'll open tickets for infra asks.
Talia (Eng Oncall): FYI infra: private deploy will need subnet peering + KMS key. I'll create infra ticket and ping infra-eng. Any expected peak qps?
Alex R: Estimate 50 rps peak, avg 10 rps. Will need GPU ded capacity for realtime chat.
Maya S: Scheduling kickoff invite and enablement: propose Tue 9-10am PT. Agenda: intros, SSO walkthrough, sample prompt tests, escalation path.
CS-Bot: Checklist created: https://cs.redwood/checklists/engagebridge-onboarding. Owner: Maya S.
Jorge L: Created ENG ticket `ENG-4128` for subnet/KMS + `CS-289` for onboarding prompts/metrics. Linking to this thread.
Maya S: Action owners: Maya -> kickoff + enablement, Jorge -> infra tickets + prompt suite, Talia -> subnet/KMS coordination, Alex -> customer intros + data access.
Alex R: I'll intro Priya & Sam on thread after this message. Priya's timezone PST.
Maya S: Also want to capture feedback loop: 2-week enablement survey + weekly health check in first 30d. Tagging renewal-watch and ops-risk.
Talia (Eng Oncall): Noted. I'll estimate time to provision: ~3 business days after subnet details.
Jorge L: If anything blocks infra beyond 3bd, escalate to eng-platform.
Maya S: Thanks all — I'll send invites and add CS runbook link. Leaving next steps in `CS-289`.
Alex R: Thanks team :thumbsup: I'll add Priya & Sam now.
Priya K: (outside) Thanks Alex — excited to get started. Looking forward to Tue.
Maya S: Welcome Priya! We'll send pre-kickoff checklist tomorrow.
